opening.argument: The stated reward comes from shopping cashback: viewers are told to share a referral link and receive 10% of the cashback earned by people they refer. The presentation places CashKaro among shopping sites and describes purchases through the service, grounding the offer in a conventional cashback and referral program. The monthly income examples of ₹10,000 or ₹15,000 are optimistic, but they do not change the participation path shown. Viewers are directed to an account signup link, with no observed request for payment, existing credentials, private keys, or account control.
